submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 has the highest efficiency of the three candidates at every threshold scanned. Its best point is 32 GeV, with 91.8% efficiency. The runner-up, Algorithm-L2, peaks at 86.1% at 38 GeV. L3 is deployable at Level-1. It fits the FPGA budget and has enough links. No latency, emulation or rate-calibration caveats were found. The L3 efficiency is flat between about 30 and 40 GeV, with fluctuations of about 1.5%. The 32 GeV optimum is therefore not sharply better than its neighbours, but it is a safe choice. The recorded steps list the 8 kHz allocated rate but do not show a direct rate measurement at 32 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: deployable_L3=1, all candidates fit the FPGA budget, links are sufficient, and no latency or emulation caveats were found.
The threshold is 32 GeV. The maximum is not at the scan edge (max_at_edge=0).

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at the allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L3 reaches 91.845% at 32 GeV, against 86.083% for L2 at 38 GeV and about 73% for L1. No rate-calibration issue was found. The 8 kHz rate at 32 GeV was not directly confirmed in the recorded results.
